CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_hole_score_to_leaderboard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tournament_id uuid;
  v_round integer;
BEGIN
  -- Turnier und Runde zuverlässig aus dem Flight bestimmen
  SELECT tournament_id, round_number
  INTO v_tournament_id, v_round
  FROM flights
  WHERE id = NEW.flight_id;

  IF v_tournament_id IS NULL OR NEW.player_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Vorhandenen Score dieses Spielers/Lochs aktualisieren
  UPDATE scores
  SET
    strokes = COALESCE(NEW.strokes_self, 0)
              + COALESCE(NEW.penalty_strokes, 0),
    registration_id = NEW.player_id,
    player_id = NEW.player_id
  WHERE tournament_id = v_tournament_id
    AND round_number = v_round
    AND hole_number = NEW.hole_number
    AND COALESCE(registration_id, player_id) = NEW.player_id;

  -- Falls noch keiner existiert: anlegen
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    INSERT INTO scores (
      tournament_id,
      round_number,
      hole_number,
      player_id,
      registration_id,
      strokes
    )
    VALUES (
      v_tournament_id,
      v_round,
      NEW.hole_number,
      NEW.player_id,
      NEW.player_id,
      COALESCE(NEW.strokes_self, 0)
        + COALESCE(NEW.penalty_strokes, 0)
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
